algorithm_long: Composition-only regression for matbench_steels. Features: the 14 elemental atomic fractions and the matminer Magpie ElementProperty statistics. Seven fixed candidate models (random forest on Magpie, random forest on fractions, extra trees on fractions+Magpie, gradient boosting on fractions, an ARD Gaussian process on fractions, and the public TabPFN-v2 regression checkpoint used as an in-context learner on fractions and on fractions+Magpie, no fine-tuning). Inside each official outer training fold, 5-fold inner cross-validation on the training rows only ranks the candidates; the prediction is the mean of the three candidates with the lowest inner-CV MAE, refitted on the whole training fold. The outer test fold is predicted once. Built with PriorLabs-TabPFN.
notes: Model choice was fixed before any outer-fold score was seen; every candidate's outer score is reported in summary.json of the run (no outer-test feedback used). CPU only (Apple silicon, 3 threads). Per-fold inner-CV ranks: {"0": ["tabpfn_fracmag", "tabpfn_frac", "et_fracmag"], "1": ["tabpfn_fracmag", "tabpfn_frac", "et_fracmag"], "2": ["tabpfn_frac", "tabpfn_fracmag", "et_fracmag"], "3": ["tabpfn_frac", "tabpfn_fracmag", "et_fracmag"], "4": ["tabpfn_fracmag", "tabpfn_frac", "et_fracmag"]} The pipeline code and this submission were prepared with an AI coding agent (Claude, Anthropic) for Quantavane; the author checked the protocol (inner-CV selection only, no outer-fold feedback) and takes responsibility for the submission.
